note: Alternative to the tuned H1 weights. Validation on the 400 held-out openings: it beats the literature weights 77.5% (tuned H1: 85.2%) but beats tuned H1 head-to-head (tuned H1 scores only 44.1% against it). Strength here is not transitive, so neither is clearly the best H1. Tuned H1 (tuned_weights.json) is the official H1, chosen by the method fixed in advance; this one is provided for transparency and as an optional extra check.
